characters.summary: Bellsprout is a slender Grass and Poison-type Pokémon that uses flexible vine whips, powder attacks, and acidic substances to subdue opponents. It can bend and sway its body with extreme fluidity to dodge attacks and anchors itself with root-like feet.

mechanisms: Flexible body to elude physical strikes

limitations: Vulnerable to extreme cold, heat, and blunt physical trauma
Limited mobility when rooted
Slow movement speed on land due to root-like feet

sources.supports: Abilities, type matchups, and general combat behavior in games and anime.

feats.claim: Uses flexible vine whips to strike opponents and bend its body to gracefully evade incoming attacks.

feats.claim: Learns and uses Vine Whip and Sleep Powder in combat
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue game data and associated early anime appearances

notableResults.note: Defeated Pikachu using agile dodging and binding vine techniques in a tournament match.
